hero.headline: Keeps you writing, *five minutes* at a time.
hero.sub: A writing habit for people who write in stolen minutes, not for a living.

screenplay.headline: A script that *looks* like a script.
screenplay.sub: Scene headings, cues and dialogue format themselves as you type, and Tab moves you on to the next line. Screenplay mode is in beta.

reminders.headline: A reminder that knows *where you left off.*
reminders.sub: Pick your days. Each reminder quotes the last lines you wrote and nudges you back into the scene.

commute.headline: Your commute is a *writing session.*
commute.sub: Dictate a line, listen back to a chapter, or run a 15 minute sprint. Offline, what you write is still saved and counted.

suggest.headline: Ciciro *suggests.* You decide.
suggest.sub: Edits arrive as tracked changes you accept or reject. The book stays yours.

exercise.headline: Write a little. Get *better* at it.
exercise.sub: A short guided exercise when you are stuck, and a weekly review of what you wrote and what to write next.

bible.headline: What color were *her eyes?*
bible.sub: Characters, places and canon live beside your chapters, one tap from the page.

themes.headline: Make it *yours.*
themes.sub: From bright paper to a candle-lit night, there is a page to suit the hour you write in.

scan.headline: Scan your *handwritten notes* into your story bible.
scan.sub: Photograph a notebook page, check what Ciciro read, then choose where it goes: your story bible or your outline cards.

feature.headline: Keeps you writing, *five minutes* at a time.
feature.kicker: For people who write around a job, a family, a life
